description: The one Todos window. Through the folder plugin the page opens the data folder Rust names at startup, by name (openFolder from @epicenter/folder), ~/Epicenter/todos, which its bundle identifier names and which the first open makes when nothing is there. The page holds no path but the one it shows. No capability names a folder. Through the folder plugin it may ask Epicenter to sync the data folder (epicenter://init) and whether Epicenter already does.
